note: Curated inputs for the Markets event dataset (tools/build_market_events.mjs). Categories define the model; `research` classifies events the research report already records (reports/tc-cycle); `events` holds facts found only in prose, each with the official source the repository already cites. Dates are server days (opening at the 10:00 Europe/Berlin server save).

otherWorlds.note: Named in tibia.com news 8475 (2025-07-30); neither in the TibiaData snapshot nor among the retired worlds with market history.

intervals.note: TibiaMarket /events dumps parsed by reports/tc-cycle/source-package/parse_events.py (calendar days, short gaps filled). An event runs from one server save to another, so its last listed calendar day holds only the morning before the save: the last server day is the day before (checked against the official schedule, reports/tc-cycle/inputs/eventschedule.json, 2026-07-03 to 2026-07-06 08:00 UTC).

XP/Skill Event.title: XP/Skill Event
XP/Skill Event.description: More experience and skill points from hunting, offline training and exercise weapons.

Skill Event.title: Skill Event
Skill Event.description: More skill points for the event's duration.

Rapid Respawn.title: Rapid Respawn
Rapid Respawn.description: Monsters respawn at a faster rate.

A Piece of Cake.title: A Piece of Cake
A Piece of Cake.description: Defeat the invading cake golems and build a bridge to a legendary island reachable only once a year. There you will have to face a challenge unlike any before. Grab your fork and be ready.

Annual Autumn Vintage.title: Annual Autumn Vintage
Annual Autumn Vintage.description: Winterberries can now be found all over Tibia! The Combined Magical Winterberry Society wants YOU to help gathering them to create the juice that keeps the magic in the world flowing: good treading!

Bewitched.title: Bewitched
Bewitched.description: Avert the wrath of evil spirits! Help the good witches to create a powerful spirit brew. Gather exotic ingredients and protect the witches' cauldron from the forces of destruction.

Carnival Month.title: Carnival Month
Carnival Month.description: Celebrate a huge costume party! Visit Stan in Venore to buy fancy costumes, colourful party hats and funny trumpets. Have a great carnival party with all of your friends.

Christmas.title: Christmas
Christmas.description: It's the most wonderful time of the year: but beware of the Grynch Clan Goblins! Have you been good all year? Then Santa might have a present for you.

Chyllfroest.title: Chyllfroest
Chyllfroest.description: An ice bridge now connects Svargrond to a frosty island, where monsters and a strange frozen creature have been sighted.

Colours of Magic.title: Colours of Magic
Colours of Magic.description: Mysterious letters with coloured powders can now be found everywhere. Choose your wizard and make your friends join your cause: what is your true colour?

Demon's Lullaby.title: Demon's Lullaby
Demon's Lullaby.description: When does a mother's burden become a hero's burden? When a demon mother decides to take a few days off. Guard her horrible children to avert her wrath. But be warned: Demon babies might prove too hot to handle.

Double Daily Reward Month.title: Double Daily Reward Month
Double Daily Reward Month.description: Make sure you collect your daily reward. If the golden sun welcomes you at the shrine all daily rewards will be doubled.

Exaltation Overload.title: Exaltation Overload
Exaltation Overload.description: An event affecting exaltation forge gameplay.

Flower Month.title: Flower Month
Flower Month.description: Remember that June is the month of flowers. If you have collected any seeds, exchange them for a flower pot with the dryad Rosemarie. But beware, wild dryads are roaming the lands again.

Full Moon.title: Full Moon
Full Moon.description: The moon is full! Beware, lycanthropic creatures like werewolves, werefoxes or werebears roam the lands now. And they are more aggressive and numerous than usual.

Halloween Event.title: Halloween Event
Halloween Event.description: This is the time of witches, ghosts and vampires. Look out for the Mutated Pumpkin and the Halloween Hare to make your flesh crawl.

Hot Cuisine Month.title: Hot Cuisine Month
Hot Cuisine Month.description: If you are a real gourmet, ask Jean Pierre in the Darama desert for some delicious and exceptional recipes. August is undoubtedly the month of hot cuisine! Bon appetit!

Last Creep Standing.title: Last Creep Standing
Last Creep Standing.description: Participate in a fun challenge of wits and agility. The trials of Kurik to test the mortals and fool around with them will lead you to a test of your reactions and luck.

Lightbearer.title: Lightbearer
Lightbearer.description: Now that the veil between the worlds is thin, darkness is striving to break through. Lucius calls for Lightbearers to keep sacred light basins burning for four days. Don't let even one go out or all hope is lost.

New Year.title: New Year
New Year.description: Make a wish in the magical night between the years and perhaps a dream will come true. Don't forget to visit Ned Nobel and buy some fireworks. Happy New Year!

Orcsoberfest.title: Orcsoberfest
Orcsoberfest.description: Join the Orgers in traditional festivities of fun and feast to earn their respect and tasty rewards!

Prank Month.title: Prank Month
Prank Month.description: Enjoy a whole month of pranks! Hoaxette is offering special spellwands, pillows and presents that all have some funny effects. One final advice: Always treat jesters well, you never know if they seek revenge one day.

Rise of Devovorga.title: Rise of Devovorga
Rise of Devovorga.description: A powerful ancient weapon meant to be sleeping forever has awoken deep under Vengoth. With thirst for revenge and burning rage she will destroy the world: unless you fight her back.

Spring into Life.title: Spring into Life
Spring into Life.description: There are unusual activities in almost all known dragon lairs. Lots of dragon eggs have been sighted in their caves.

The First Dragon.title: The First Dragon
The First Dragon.description: Search for traces of the First Dragon and his descendants. Find out if there is more to the tale of a beautiful festive garment that has been lost ever since it fell into its claws.

The Great Expedition.title: The Great Expedition
The Great Expedition.description: Support Proprietor Piers and join the Great Expedition in Thais. Work together with your friends to keep the wharf safe and the construction running to help get this endeavour on the way. Assemble the perfect crew for the journey and set sail to new horizons!

Tibia Anniversary.title: Tibia Anniversary
Tibia Anniversary.description: Let's celebrate! It's Tibia's birthday! Join us for the party and take part in the festivities! Many exciting activities await you. Try your luck on the piñata dragons. Visit the islands Vigintia and Nostalgia for fun things like can knockdown and a treasure hunt, or take a trip down memory lane.

Valentine's Day.title: Valentine's Day
Valentine's Day.description: Romantic times! Buy Valentine's cakes, flower bouquets, heart backpacks and other romantic items for your loved one from Valentina in Greenshore.

Winterlight Solstice.title: Winterlight Solstice
Winterlight Solstice.description: The days are getting colder and grisly, shaggy creatures are roaming the lands. Are you brave enough to face their queen in her frozen lair? Anyhow, don't forget: You are already halfway out of the dark!

Tibia Token fee 6%->8%.title: Tibia Token fee raised to 8%
Tibia Token fee 6%->8%.description: The Tibia Token fee rose from 6% to 8%.

events.title: Luzibra opened
events.description: Luzibra opened as a new game world.

events.title: Terribra opened
events.description: Terribra opened as a new game world, formed by the merge of Jacabra and Obscubra.

events.title: Floribra opened
events.description: Floribra opened as a new game world.

events.title: Premium restriction lifted
events.description: Kalimera, Luzibra and Sonera opened to free accounts at the server save.

events.title: Transfer block lifted
events.description: Ambra, Flamera and Wadira accepted character transfers again from the server save.
